    Naming your Assassin

    The Assassin is Aion 2's stealth melee class. It strikes from the shadows, deals huge burst damage and relies on timing and positioning. Your name should feel quick and quiet. Sibilant sounds (s, sh, z), sharp vowels and x or ix endings fit perfectly: Vexira, Shiyss, Nyrix.

    Asmodian Assassins naturally lean toward the shadows, so names like Zyrix or Triniel-inspired Trinka feel at home. Elyos Assassins can be just as deadly with lighter, elegant names like Saelith. Choose the Short & clean tone for names of five letters or fewer.

    Quick tips

    • Under 7 letters is ideal. Assassins should be hard to read and hard to catch.
    • Soft S and SH sounds mixed with a sharp X or K make a name feel like a blade.
    • Compound ideas: Nightfang, Duskwhisper, Shadowveil, Ashstep.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What makes a good Assassin name?

    Short, sharp and a little mysterious. Names like Vex, Nyrix, Shade or Duskfang suit the class's stealthy burst play style.

    Can I generate female Assassin names?

    Yes. Set Gender to Female and Class to Assassin and the generator uses feminine endings such as -ira, -yss and -ith.

    How do I use the Assassin name generator?

    The class is already set to Assassin. Choose Elyos or Asmodian, pick a gender and tone, then hit Generate. Click any name to copy it, or ☆ to save it to your shortlist.
